name: Steel Fabricators LLC
old_description: Founded in 1962, Steel Fabricators, LLC has been involved in the construction of hundreds of recognized and highly regarded projects across the nation.  Our customers have been able to rely upon us to meet the precise standards and requirements of their projects regardless of schedule, scope, size, or complexity.  We are the single-source structural steel fabrication company of choice, and our complete in-house capabilities allow for fast response, maximum flexibility, and unparalleled coordination on all phases of the project.  You will find Steel Fabricators to be the most experienced, innovative, responsive, and customer focused fabricator in the industry!
about:
Steel Fabricators LLC was founded in 1962 in Oakland Park, Florida. The company operates its main offices in Fort Lauderdale and maintains a regional office in Orlando. It functions as a subsidiary of FabSouth, a larger construction group.

The firm specializes in structural steel fabrication and erection, offering complete in-house capabilities that cover the full project lifecycle. It holds AISC certification as both a fabricator and erector, and is a Florida-licensed general contractor. The company reports a bonding capacity of $125 million per project and $625 million in aggregate, with an experience modification rate (EMR) of 0.67. Its portfolio includes hundreds of projects nationwide, ranging from commercial buildings to large-scale entertainment venues.

Steel Fabricators serves clients in commercial construction, entertainment, marine infrastructure, and public-sector projects. Notable projects include the F3 Marina in Fort Lauderdale, the Broward County Convention Center, the Formula One facilities at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge in Orlando, Hard Rock Live in Hollywood, and Port of Miami Cruise Terminal A. Customers include developers, general contractors, and public agencies seeking a single-source steel provider.

The company distinguishes itself through its integrated in-house fabrication and erection teams, which it says enable fast response, maximum flexibility, and coordinated execution across all project phases. It positions itself as a single-source structural steel partner capable of handling projects regardless of schedule, scope, size, or complexity.
